_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The drawer shows a running-task gear count that opens the conversation. The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list and cut off its live update stream, so there is nothing to set up, intercept or check about that (do not look at the API): the drawer (".drawer") shows the conversations the test names, as rows [data-conversation-id="<id>"] whose title (".conversation-title") is their slug, which is their id (drafts have none), and whose preview is "Preview". The list is "parent", which has one background job running. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. A button "X" is button[aria-label="X"] when one exists (as for "Open conversations", "Search conversations...", "Search tasks...", "View options", "Show chapters", "Archive", "Restore" and "Delete"); otherwise it is the button whose visible text is exactly X, picked with has_text X (a substring match, so make sure no other button's text contains X), as for "Ask Shelley", "View Archived" and "Back to conversations". 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The parent row's ".drawer-working-indicator" is visible. 3. The row's data-testid "conversation-running-work" element's trimmed text is exactly "1" (assert_text trims), its title is "1 task running", its aria-label "1 task running", and it has a visible svg inside. 4. The compact indicator is part of the ordinary row target, and no longer expands job logs in the drawer: click it. 5. The URL's path should become exactly /c/parent (poll eval "location.pathname"). 6. There is no element with data-testid "background-job".
